UnityMCP.comment: IvanMurzak Unity-MCP. Port moved 8080 -> 8090: 8080 is owned by the CoplayDev server registered as 'unityMCP' in .claude/settings.json. The Unity-side plugin (UserSettings/AI-Game-Developer-Config.json) is set to connectionMode=Cloud, so it targets the ai-game-developer hub and stays disconnected until that connector is authorized.
